::: {.protected-content}

::: {.function-badge}
[Obfuscation](../function/obfuscation.qmd)
:::

Undisclosed paid influencers are individuals or entities covertly compensated by a state or actor to promote specific narratives while concealing their financial or organizational ties. This form of information manipulation leverages the perceived independence of these influencers to legitimize and amplify targeted messages, thereby shaping public opinion without revealing the orchestrated nature of the communication.

:::
